deployments_detail.use: i-Tech 7 (Subsea 7 Life of Field unit) strategic collaboration with Shell to accelerate subsea digitalisation adopting marine robotics advanced sensing and AI

Automated AI workflow for subsea pipeline inspection: machine-learning system processes ROV/survey inspection footage and data, cutting processing time and accelerating inspection cadence. Attributed to Subsea7 Digital lead Hugh Ferguson in the Deep 7 Technology Magazine 2020. [Subsea7 (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: Automated AI workflow reduces processing time by over 50%

deployments_detail.use: Data-automation for integrity inspections: automating cathodic protection (CP) inspections and using visual-recognition/computer-vision systems to automatically identify features on subsea pipelines and structures from inspection video. [Subsea7 (in-house)]

Autonomous Inspection Vehicle (AIV) for unmanned inspection of pipelines, umbilicals, risers and subsea structures, using Deep Learning and Machine Vision for autonomous navigation and feature/visual inspection. [Subsea7 (in-house)]

4insight Marine Operations (DynOps): machine-learning decision-support that fuses live vessel motion/IoT sensor data with weather forecasts (on Microsoft Azure) to predict vessel operability windows, recommend headings and helicopter landing windows, and reduce weather downtime. Deployed on Subsea7 construction vessels. [4Subsea (Subsea7 subsidiary), Microsoft Azure]
deployments_detail.value: In 2025 added ~35 days of operation to the vessel Seven Vega, an uplift of over 10%

deployments_detail.use: 4insight Asset Integrity: machine-learning anomaly-detection on live sensor/monitoring data from subsea infrastructure (risers, pipelines, moorings) with digital-twin models to provide data-driven decision support and reduce inspection cost. [4Subsea (Subsea7 subsidiary)]

Acquisition of digital-services provider 4Subsea to bring advanced algorithms and AI plus digital twins in-house for asset-integrity insights and decision support across Life of Field / field development contracts. [4Subsea (acquired by Subsea7)]

Five-year digitalisation partnership between i-Tech 7 (Subsea7 division) and Leidos to apply big data, artificial intelligence and automation to ROV/diving intervention, survey, inspection and integrity data acquisition and processing, reducing operating costs. [Leidos (with i-Tech 7 / Subsea7)]

Joint Subsea7 / 4Subsea project to monitor key operational data on Subsea7 vessels using advanced algorithms, AI and digital twins to digitalise and optimise marine operations. [4Subsea (Subsea7 subsidiary)]
